integrity.mathematical_scope: Finite approval profiles with sunflower ballots; all nonnegative real virtual budgets; fixed priority; uncompleted rule.
integrity.proof_basis: Common-core strict minimum-price selection, autonomous equal-balance petal groups, exact integer threshold counts, constructive three-voter witness.
integrity.unproved: No assertion for completion procedures, unequal project costs, general non-sunflower ballots, or variable tie policies.
integrity.verification: 156245 exact-rational formula comparisons and two complete rational witness traces using embedded standalone verifier.

scientific_limitations: Applies to uncompleted approval-based equal shares with unit project costs and one fixed budget-independent candidate priority.
Sunflower profiles permit arbitrary numbers and sizes of private petals, but crossed support sets can violate the conclusion.
The three-voter counterexample is tie-sensitive; minimum candidate count and tie-independent violations are not asserted.
The all-real-budget guarantee is proved symbolically; finite rational checks alone do not establish it.
External specialist priority has not been independently established.
title: Exact budget paths and a sharp three-voter nesting boundary for equal shares
